title: Thermochemical method for controlling pore structure to enhance hydrogen storage capacity of biochar
material_description: CS-700-1 | corn-straw biochar (pyrolysed at 600 °C under N2, pickled in 0.2 mol/L H2SO4) KOH-activated at 700 °C with KOH/char mass ratio 1:1, then acid-washed
purification_method: 0.2 mol/L H2SO4 pickling of the 600 °C char before activation (liquid/solid 40:1, 24 h, room temperature, air, to remove AAEMs); after activation 0.2 mol/L H2SO4 wash (40:1, 4 h, room temperature), repeated deionized-water washing to constant pH, drying
activation_method: KOH melt activation at 700 °C, KOH/char mass ratio 1:1, N2 1 L/min, 5 °C/min, 30 min hold, nickel crucible in corundum tube, 2 ± 0.010 g char per run
source_location: main p.5 (journal p. 21803), Fig. 2(C), series a-700-1 (legend filled symbol), marker C_a3-700-1#0
notes: archive: HYC-0137_Fig2C_a-700-1.json. Tool run C_a3-700-1 point 0, 13 px. Absolute values are computed by the authors from the excess data of the same run (Eq. (3)); the excess isotherm of this run is I8. Point count is a lower bound: markers in the low-pressure stack (P < ~3 bar) overlap and could not all be counted (log.md). Sample: Table 4 (N2 at -196 °C, BSD-PM analyser; degassed 250 °C, 180 min for N2 sorption). BET P/P0 range not stated. A_micro by t-plot; A_meso (stored as external_surface_area_m2_g) and V_meso are by difference (BET − A_micro, V_total − V_micro); V_total single point at P/P0 = 0.99; V_micro by H-K. average_pore_diameter_nm is d1 = 4V/A (BET) adsorption average; BJH desorption average d2 = 4.10 nm. H2: gravimetric, "maglev balance" readings with buoyancy term (Vsc + Vs)ρg in Eq. (1); instrument named only as "PSD-PH device" (no manufacturer); how Vs/Vsc were determined is not stated. Degassed in vacuum at 300 °C for 120 min before H2 (degas_duration_h = 120 min / 60). Measurement temperature printed as -196 °C (stored 77.15 K).
basis_evidence: p. 21802, Eqs. (1)-(3): "mex indicates the excess adsorption capacity of hydrogen" (mex = Δm − msc − ms + (Vsc + Vs)ρg) and "mabs indicates the absolute adsorption capacity of hydrogen" (mabs = mex/(1 − ρg/ρa)); p. 21808: "Fig. 2(C) and (F) are the absolute adsorption-desorption and excess adsorption-desorption isotherms of hydrogen in different biochar samples, respectively" and "The absolute hydrogen storage capacity of biochar under different pressures is summarized in Table 6"; Fig. 2 caption "(C) Absolute adsorption curve of hydrogen"

purification_method: 0.2 mol/L H2SO4 pickling of the 600 °C char before activation (liquid/solid 40:1, 24 h, room temperature, air, to remove AAEMs); after activation 0.2 mol/L H2SO4 wash (40:1, 4 h, room temperature), repeated deionized-water washing to constant pH, drying
activation_method: KOH melt activation at 900 °C, KOH/char mass ratio 2:1, N2 1 L/min, 5 °C/min, 30 min hold, nickel crucible in corundum tube, 2 ± 0.010 g char per run
source_location: main p.5 (journal p. 21803), Fig. 2(C), series d-900-2 (legend open symbol), marker C_d-900-2#6
notes: archive: HYC-0137_Fig2C_d-900-2.json. Tool run C_d-900-2 point 6, 29 px. Absolute values are computed by the authors from the excess data of the same run (Eq. (3)); the excess isotherm of this run is I12. Point count is a lower bound: markers in the low-pressure stack (P < ~3 bar) overlap and could not all be counted (log.md). Sample: Table 4 (N2 at -196 °C, BSD-PM analyser; degassed 250 °C, 180 min for N2 sorption). BET P/P0 range not stated. A_micro by t-plot; A_meso (stored as external_surface_area_m2_g) and V_meso are by difference (BET − A_micro, V_total − V_micro); V_total single point at P/P0 = 0.99; V_micro by H-K. average_pore_diameter_nm is d1 = 4V/A (BET) adsorption average; BJH desorption average d2 = 2.70 nm. H2: gravimetric, "maglev balance" readings with buoyancy term (Vsc + Vs)ρg in Eq. (1); instrument named only as "PSD-PH device" (no manufacturer); how Vs/Vsc were determined is not stated. Degassed in vacuum at 300 °C for 120 min before H2 (degas_duration_h = 120 min / 60). Measurement temperature printed as -196 °C (stored 77.15 K).
basis_evidence: p. 21802, Eqs. (1)-(3): "mex indicates the excess adsorption capacity of hydrogen" (mex = Δm − msc − ms + (Vsc + Vs)ρg) and "mabs indicates the absolute adsorption capacity of hydrogen" (mabs = mex/(1 − ρg/ρa)); p. 21808: "Fig. 2(C) and (F) are the absolute adsorption-desorption and excess adsorption-desorption isotherms of hydrogen in different biochar samples, respectively" and "The absolute hydrogen storage capacity of biochar under different pressures is summarized in Table 6"; Fig. 2 caption "(C) Absolute adsorption curve of hydrogen"

notes: archive: HYC-0137_Fig2F_a-700-1.json. Tool run F_a3-700-1 point 10, 11 px. The absolute isotherm of this run (Eq. (3)) is I1. Point count is a lower bound: markers in the low-pressure stack (P < ~3 bar) overlap and could not all be counted (log.md). Sample: Table 4 (N2 at -196 °C, BSD-PM analyser; degassed 250 °C, 180 min for N2 sorption). BET P/P0 range not stated. A_micro by t-plot; A_meso (stored as external_surface_area_m2_g) and V_meso are by difference (BET − A_micro, V_total − V_micro); V_total single point at P/P0 = 0.99; V_micro by H-K. average_pore_diameter_nm is d1 = 4V/A (BET) adsorption average; BJH desorption average d2 = 4.10 nm. source_location: main p.5 (journal p. 21803), Fig. 2(F), series d-900-1 (legend open symbol), marker F_d-900-1#3
notes: archive: HYC-0137_Fig2F_d-900-1.json. Tool run F_d-900-1 point 3, 11 px. partly occluded marker (centroid of visible part). The absolute isotherm of this run (Eq. (3)) is I3. Point count is a lower bound: markers in the low-pressure stack (P < ~3 bar) overlap and could not all be counted (log.md). Sample: Table 4 (N2 at -196 °C, BSD-PM analyser; degassed 250 °C, 180 min for N2 sorption). BET P/P0 range not stated. H2: gravimetric, "maglev balance" readings with buoyancy term (Vsc + Vs)ρg in Eq. (1); instrument named only as "PSD-PH device" (no manufacturer); how Vs/Vsc were determined is not stated. purification_method: 0.2 mol/L H2SO4 pickling of the 600 °C char before activation (liquid/solid 40:1, 24 h, room temperature, air, to remove AAEMs); after activation 0.2 mol/L H2SO4 wash (40:1, 4 h, room temperature), repeated deionized-water washing to constant pH, drying
activation_method: KOH melt activation at 1000 °C, KOH/char mass ratio 1:1, N2 1 L/min, 5 °C/min, 30 min hold, nickel crucible in corundum tube, 2 ± 0.010 g char per run
source_location: main p.5 (journal p. 21803), Fig. 2(F), series d-1000-1 (legend open symbol), marker F_d-1000-1#4
notes: archive: HYC-0137_Fig2F_d-1000-1.json. Tool run F_d-1000-1 point 4, 33 px. The absolute isotherm of this run (Eq. (3)) is I4. Point count is a lower bound: markers in the low-pressure stack (P < ~3 bar) overlap and could not all be counted (log.md). Sample: Table 4 (N2 at -196 °C, BSD-PM analyser; degassed 250 °C, 180 min for N2 sorption). BET P/P0 range not stated. A_micro by t-plot; A_meso (stored as external_surface_area_m2_g) and V_meso are by difference (BET − A_micro, V_total − V_micro); V_total single point at P/P0 = 0.99; V_micro by H-K. average_pore_diameter_nm is d1 = 4V/A (BET) adsorption average; BJH desorption average d2 = 3.13 nm. H2: gravimetric, "maglev balance" readings with buoyancy term (Vsc + Vs)ρg in Eq. (1); instrument named only as "PSD-PH device" (no manufacturer); how Vs/Vsc were determined is not stated. purification_method: 0.2 mol/L H2SO4 pickling of the 600 °C char before activation (liquid/solid 40:1, 24 h, room temperature, air, to remove AAEMs); after activation 0.2 mol/L H2SO4 wash (40:1, 4 h, room temperature), repeated deionized-water washing to constant pH, drying

source_location: main p.5 (journal p. 21803), Fig. 2(F), series d-900-3 (legend open symbol), marker F_d-900-3#12
notes: archive: HYC-0137_Fig2F_d-900-3.json. Tool run F_d-900-3 point 12, 29 px. The absolute isotherm of this run (Eq. (3)) is I6. Point count is a lower bound: markers in the low-pressure stack (P < ~3 bar) overlap and could not all be counted (log.md). Sample: Table 4 (N2 at -196 °C, BSD-PM analyser; degassed 250 °C, 180 min for N2 sorption). BET P/P0 range not stated. A_micro by t-plot; A_meso (stored as external_surface_area_m2_g) and V_meso are by difference (BET − A_micro, V_total − V_micro); V_total single point at P/P0 = 0.99; V_micro by H-K. average_pore_diameter_nm is d1 = 4V/A (BET) adsorption average; BJH desorption average d2 = 2.33 nm. H2: gravimetric, "maglev balance" readings with buoyancy term (Vsc + Vs)ρg in Eq. (1); instrument named only as "PSD-PH device" (no manufacturer); how Vs/Vsc were determined is not stated. notes: archive: HYC-0137_Fig2F_d-900-4.json. Tool run F_d-900-4 point 9, 24 px. The absolute isotherm of this run (Eq. (3)) is I7. Point count is a lower bound: markers in the low-pressure stack (P < ~3 bar) overlap and could not all be counted (log.md). Sample: Table 4 (N2 at -196 °C, BSD-PM analyser; degassed 250 °C, 180 min for N2 sorption). BET P/P0 range not stated.
